name: Cow
heading: Cattle, Cow
sourceWitness: Local first-printing facsimile  The edition credit appears on page 3.
errataEvidence: The Wizards of the Coast v3.0 errata contains no changes to these entries.
habitatEvidence: Grassland and pasture are editorial tags for domestic cattle. Appendix C lists the rothé under grassland and the ox under urban, each identified as a Cow variant.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the roster portrait.
sourceNotes: The Cow base block supplies Charge and Gore. Cattle gives separate instructions for applying the variants on p. 208.

name: Deep Rothé
heading: Cattle, Cow and Rothé
sourceWitness: Local first-printing facsimile  The edition credit appears on page 3.
errataEvidence: The Wizards of the Coast v3.0 errata contains no changes to these entries.
habitatEvidence: The p. 208 account names the Underdark. Appendix C lists Cow (deep rothé) under Underdark Creatures and confirms CR 1/4 (50 XP).
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the roster portrait.
sourceNotes: Cattle on p. 207 directs the reader to start with the Cow stat block and apply the named variant changes. Rothé on p. 208 gives the Deep Rothé’s size, HP, darkvision and innate spellcasting.
AC, 30-ft. speed, ability scores, passive Perception, Charge and Gore come from Cow. The published variant communicates by magical flashes and adds no language to the Cow line.
